project.idea: 无限画布 vs 终端界面下的多 agent 使用模式对比：研究知识工作者在协调多个 AI agent 时的策略、认知负荷与产出质量差异

phases.label: Pre
phases.description: Idea shaping, literature retrieval, novelty judgment, and topic keep/pivot decisions.

phases.label: Mid
phases.description: Study design, optional questionnaire or prototype work, deployment, collection, and analysis setup.

phases.label: Post
phases.description: Writing, result synthesis, and conclusion-building after the experimental work is complete.

workflow.label: Research Brief
workflow.description: Translate the raw idea into a concrete HCI problem, users, contribution, and constraints.

workflow.label: Novelty Matrix
workflow.description: Search adjacent work, validate citations, and decide keep / pivot / drop.

workflow.label: Study Spec
workflow.label_zh: 研究设计与问卷/原型方案
workflow.description: Decide whether a user study, questionnaire, prototype, or mixed-methods setup is needed and specify it.

workflow.label: Deployment and Collection
workflow.description: Prepare deployment, questionnaire distribution, session flow, monitoring, and data collection readiness.

workflow.label: Analysis and Findings
workflow.description: Pre-commit analysis logic and define how the study data will turn into concrete findings.

workflow.label: Writing and Synthesis
workflow.description: Turn the findings into a paper narrative, synthesize results, and prepare LaTeX drafting.
